fixtureDigestScope: UTF-8 bytes of the fixtures array serialized as recursively key-sorted compact JSON with no trailing newline
profileDigestScope: UTF-8 bytes of the complete top-level profile object with only profileDigest omitted, serialized as recursively key-sorted compact JSON with no trailing newline

contractBindings.digestScope: Exact UTF-8 file bytes as committed, including LF line endings and the final newline

execution.concurrencyRule: All ten workers wait at a barrier before each request ordinal, then each issues exactly one request and waits for it to finish before the next barrier.
execution.fixtureAssignment: Each scenario has exactly one approved fixture. Every worker uses that fixture with a unique actor/session/idempotency-key namespace derived only from scenario, workerIndex, and requestOrdinal; warm-up ordinals are 0-1 and measured ordinals reset to 0-9.
execution.warmupFailurePolicy: Both warm-up requests per worker must succeed within 5000 milliseconds. Any failure aborts the profile as failed and cannot be replaced or excluded.
execution.timeoutPolicy: Cancel at 5000 milliseconds. A timeout or non-success response remains one of the 100 measured attempts, is a threshold failure, retains its raw outcome, and contributes 5000 milliseconds to nearest-rank p95.
execution.percentile: nearest-rank p95 over all 100 measured values; rank=ceil(0.95*100)=95 after ascending sort
execution.clock: A monotonic clock in the process that owns each scenario boundary; wall-clock timestamps may be retained only as supplemental evidence.

bff_session_bootstrap.route: POST /api/v1/identity/session-bootstrap via the BFF lifecycle gate
bff_session_bootstrap.timingStart: BFF lifecycle-gate dispatch immediately before the core bootstrap call.
bff_session_bootstrap.timingStop: Validated active core response plus committed Redis session activation acknowledgement.

bff_session_refresh.timingStart: BFF Fastify request-handler entry after route matching.
bff_session_refresh.timingStop: Completion of the validated session response serialization after idle-touch commit when applicable.

bff_logout.timingStart: BFF Fastify request-handler entry after route matching.
bff_logout.timingStop: Emission of the cookie-clearing 303 response after authoritative local revocation.

authentication_callback.timingStop: Emission of the post-bootstrap 303 redirect after session activation.
authentication_callback.excludedTime: Employee interaction and Entra time before the callback request reaches the BFF.
